title: The Covering of the Tabernacle
theme: The tabernacle’s coverings illustrate Christ’s consecration, substitutionary sacrifice, and unrecognized glory.
proposition: Christ’s humble appearance conceals His divine glory, which is approached through His sacrificial atonement and self-surrender.
sermonQuestion: How do the tabernacle’s coverings help us see Christ for who He really is?

outline.heading: The Rams’ Skins were placed over the Tabernacle before the Badger Skins (Ex. 2:14).
In this covering you get a perfect picture of Our Lord Jesus Christ as he passed through the World, as he appeared in the Eyes of Men.
How can you see Christ for who he really is?

legacyImport.contentPreservation: Original Josh Hetrick legacy sermon preserved unchanged.
